title: Identification of tofersen PD-response biomarkers in VALOR clinical trial CSF via multiplexed quantitative proteomics
data_availability_text: Data and code availability •All data were acquired using commercially available software. Mass spectrometry data were acquired in Xcalibur (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and analyzed using the Sequest search engine built into GFY Core v.3.8 (licensed through Harvard University). Immunoassay data were acquired using SoftMax Pro GxP (v.5.3). Raw mass spectrometry data have been deposited online at ProteomeXchange (PXD061717) and MassIVE (MSV000097291) and are accessible through the following links: https://proteomecentral.proteomexchange.org/cgi/GetDataset?ID=PXD061717;https://massive.ucsd.edu/ProteoSAFe/dataset.jsp?task=9ff8a636b76f4e3aad931d2f0323e262.•This study does not report new algorithms or computational models. Data were analyzed as described in the STAR Methods in Python (v.2.7.11) and R (v.4.2.1).•Any additional information required to reanalyze the data reported in this paper is available from the lead contact upon request.
